sources.entry: iOS Images Extractor - iOS Images Extractor is a Mac app to normalize, decode, and extract images from iOS apps.

summary.one_liner: A Mac app that normalizes, decodes, and extracts images from iOS apps and asset catalogs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS desktop app that takes iOS image sources and pulls out their images. It names three supported inputs: PNG and JPG files, IPA app packages, and compiled Assets.car asset catalogs. The v0.4.0 change log says the extractor was replaced with Timac/QLCARFiles and that the app can export raw PDF files. Output is organized into folders, and the app can quickly install QLCARFiles, a macOS QuickLook plugin, to visualize .car files. The README also says the app normalizes and decodes images, though it does not detail how. Source is built from Xcode using a git submodule.
use_cases: extract images from an iOS app IPA file
pull image assets out of Assets.car
export PDF assets from an iOS asset catalog
decode and normalize iOS png or jpg images on a Mac
notable: Extracts from compiled Assets.car catalogs as well as IPA packages
Uses Timac/QLCARFiles as its extraction engine since v0.4.0
Can install QLCARFiles QuickLook plugin for .car previews
Exports raw PDF files from asset catalogs
caveats: Build requires cloning submodules and opening the Xcode workspace
Latest documented release is v0.4.0 from 2020; activity since then is not stated
keywords: get assets from ios app bundle
